prompt: 把我 Figma 里这 4 个界面拿去当陀螺互相打一架，看哪个最后还在转
expectedBehaviors: Confirms the lineup is 2–7 screens before starting
Reads the shared Figma MCP guide, then get_metadata for structural features and get_screenshot for a PNG per frame
Starts server.cjs with --project-dir/--port and records battleDir, screensDir, configPath, and url from the JSON response
Writes battle-config.json with a screens[] array (name/image/structure) whose image paths resolve under screensDir
Reports the arena url and the source mode (Figma MCP vs screenshot-only)

prompt: Turn these 5 Figma screens into spinning beyblades and let them fight each other in an arena — last one spinning wins
expectedBehaviors: Treats the request as a fun/demo battle, not production UI work
Derives per-screen structural features (nodes, textNodes, depth, fills) from Figma and saves one screenshot per screen
Saves each PNG into screensDir and references it with a battle-dir-relative path in battle-config.json
curl-verifies battle-config.json and every image path returns 200 before handing off
Tells the user to open the arena url, where stats and the battle run automatically

prompt: 我没有 Figma，只有几张截图，能不能让它们变成战斗陀螺在竞技场里对战
expectedBehaviors: Falls back to user-attached images when Figma MCP is unavailable and omits the structure field
States the source mode is screenshot-only so the browser derives all stats from pixels
Still writes battle-config.json and starts the server so the arena can run
Does not attempt to read from or write back to Figma

prompt: 把这 8 个 Figma frame 都做成 beyblade battle，选最能打的界面
expectedBehaviors: Notices more than 7 screens and asks the user to pick 7 before proceeding
Gathers structure + screenshot for each chosen frame via Figma MCP
Explains stats are blended from Figma structure and screenshot pixels, and a top is out below 50% integrity or when spin runs out
Never writes back to Figma and points to brainstorm/prototype/push-to-figma for real UI work
